name: ITI Fitter Theory Semester 1 & 2 - Practice Test 1

questions.question: Which instrument is used to check the flatness of a surface?
questions.hint: A Try Square is used to check the squareness and flatness of surfaces.

questions.question: What is the unit of pitch of a thread?
questions.hint: Pitch is measured in mm in metric threads.

questions.question: Which file is used for filing wood?
questions.hint: A rasps cut file is designed for woodworking and filing soft materials.

questions.question: What is the least count of a standard Vernier Caliper?
questions.hint: Standard metric Vernier Calipers have a least count of 0.02 mm.

questions.question: Which metal is used to make hammer heads?
questions.hint: Hammer heads are typically made of forged high carbon steel.

questions.question: What is the angle of a center punch?
questions.hint: A center punch has a point angle of 90 degrees to make deep marks for drilling.

questions.question: Which is the safest method to lift heavy loads in a workshop?
questions.hint: Using hoists, cranes, or jacks is the safest way to move heavy machinery/loads.

questions.question: What is the least count of an outside micrometer?
questions.hint: A metric outside micrometer has a standard least count of 0.01 mm.

questions.question: How is the size of a bench vice specified?
questions.hint: A bench vice size is specified by the width of its jaws.

questions.question: Which material is used to manufacture hacksaw blades?
questions.hint: Hacksaw blades are typically made of High Speed Steel (HSS) or High Carbon Steel.

questions.question: Which coolant is recommended for drilling cast iron?
questions.hint: Cast iron is drilled dry because its graphite acts as a self-lubricant and oil creates sticky chips.

questions.question: What is the pitch of a standard hacksaw blade for general purpose sheet cutting?
questions.hint: A pitch of 1.8 mm (14 TPI) is standard for general workshop steel and sheet metal cutting.

questions.question: Which type of thread is provided on the lead screw of a lathe machine?
questions.hint: Acme threads (29-degree angle) are provided on lead screws for power transmission.

questions.question: Which caliper is used to draw lines parallel to the outer edges of a workpiece?
questions.hint: Jenny calipers (hermaphrodite calipers) have one bent leg to locate edges and draw parallel layout lines.

questions.question: Which heat treatment process is used to increase the wear resistance of steel tools?
questions.hint: Hardening increases the hardness and wear resistance of steel carbon tools.
